title: Pin the null opt-in window and count the backfill from under its lock
action: Two proof-layer fixes (role-edge-hardening D1 items 4-5). (a) verbs/drivers/tests.rs: pin host_opted_into_roles null boundary - a models table of {code:null} or {read:null} counts as OPTED IN (window shut), an empty or absent table does not; the r2 mutation probe showed narrowing .is_some() to non-null leaves the whole suite green, so this exact fixture is the missing tooth. Also pin role_is_unknown for a null-valued slot (present-but-null is KNOWN - it resolves Budget, never warns). These tests pin CURRENT intended semantics; if either fails on unfixed code something is wrong with the diagnosis - stop and report rather than changing code to match. (b) verbs/cells/handlers_write.rs backfill: derive already_roled and unmapped from the same under-lock fresh reads the writes use (the re-read loop from 00fd53b6), so every reported count describes the state the writes actually saw; update the doc block at ~:1910 so its claim is true (r3 A P4). Test: interleave a concurrent role-write during the pass (existing backfill_roles_interleaved seam) and assert already_roled counts the fresh state, not the stale scan.

truths: A null-valued code or read slot counts as opted-in and the fixture would fail under the non-null mutation
A null-valued slot is known to role_is_unknown - resolves Budget, never warns
already_roled and unmapped are derived under the lock from fresh reads, pinned by an interleaved test
The doc block claim about count provenance is true after the change
backfill dry-run and apply report identical counts on a quiet store

trace.outcome: the opt-in window's null boundary is pinned by a mutation-proven test, and the backfill's count provenance is stated exactly with the movable direction folded from fresh reads
deviations: Counts-under-lock must-have narrowed with recorded reason: full recount would undo the P1-B short-hold lock design.

report.outcome: a_null_valued_asked_role_is_an_opt_in_and_the_window_shuts pins the boundary and was PROVEN to bite: the exact r2 mutation (.is_some -> non-null) applied, the test failed at its named assertion, mutation reverted. already_roled now counts a role gained during the scan window from the under-lock fresh reading, pinned by an interleaved test; the doc block states the count split exactly. Named deviation from the cell text: full under-lock recounting was narrowed because it would hold the archive lock across a whole store re-scan, undoing the P1-B short-hold design — the one direction the count can move is folded instead, and role has no removal door so no other direction exists.
